BankTransaction.title: BankTransaction
BankTransaction.description: A parsed or manually logged financial transaction (expense or income) linked to a bank, debit, credit, or wallet instrument.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

type.description: Whether the transaction is an expense (debit) or income (credit).

instrument.description: Payment instrument detected from the SMS or chosen manually.

amountCents.description: Positive transaction amount in minor currency units (e.g., cents/paise).

currency.description: ISO currency code such as USD, INR, EUR, GBP.

bankName.description: Detected bank or card issuer name.

accountLast4.description: Last 4 digits of card or bank account, if detected.

messageHash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of source SMS/text for deduplication.

note.description: Optional note or brief parsed summary.

transactionTimeMillis.description: Transaction timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: User budget target and display preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

defaultCurrency.description: Preferred ISO currency code for manual entry and summaries.

monthlyBudgetCents.description: Monthly spending budget in minor currency units (0 means unset).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Per-user expense and income transactions parsed from bank SMS or entered manually.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Per-user budget and currency preference documents.
